name: Locrio (Dominican Chicken and Rice)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 4 lbs (1.8 kg) chicken, cut in pieces
2 tbsp oil, for when rice is almost done

steps: Proceed with the recipe as above, using an oven-proof pot, until the rice absorbs all the liquid. Once this happens, cover the pot, put it in the oven, and bake for 30 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp oil, and stir so the uncooked rice is on the bottom and the bottom rice is on the top. Bake for another 20 minutes.
Stir. If it is still not fully cooked, bake another 20 minutes.

culture.text: A locrio is a rice dish from the Dominican Republic. Similar to pilaf, jollof, and paella, it consists of seasoned rice with some kind of meat, such as chicken, Dominican salami or pork.
